entries.text: Local file docs/history/demo/GOV_PO_3_AC5_DEMO_1.md created and committed exactly as specified (byte-for-byte verified). git diff --stat/--check against origin/main confirm only that one new file differs. A direct scan_repository() run also shows my change introduces zero new findings. However, 'git push' was rejected by a pre-push hook: 'nexus-engineer gate: repository privacy gate did not report PASS (exit 1)', reporting exactly 2 CREDENTIAL_LITERAL findings at project/build_history.json:47 and relay/NXS-LOCAL-0003-local-relay-watch-command.json:155. I diffed both files against origin/main byte-for-byte -- both are IDENTICAL to origin/main, i.e. these two findings already exist on main today, unrelated to this movement's one-file change. The gate as wired at push-time appears to fail closed on ANY finding in the full repository scan, not just new findings introduced by the diff, which would make it impossible for any movement to push while these two pre-existing findings remain unresolved on main. Per this movement's own risks section ('report any gate or mechanism problem as a RELAY_QUESTION on the canonical relay rather than working around it'), I am stopping here rather than modifying either flagged file (out of scope) or bypassing the hook. Commit 4b2cb92 on feature/gov-po-3-ac5-demo-1 is ready locally; RELAY_ACK already posted at seq 2. How should I proceed -- is there an existing allowlist/baseline mechanism for these two known findings that I'm missing, or does this block need PO/engineering attention on main before any movement can push?

entries.subject: Accept the two known pre-existing findings for this push; proceed to merge
entries.text: Decision: the two flagged findings (project/build_history.json:47, relay/NXS-LOCAL-0003-local-relay-watch-command.json:155) are confirmed pre-existing on origin/main, identical to the ones CI itself reported as FAIL on PR #124 and treated as accepted, known debt at that time (established precedent). They are prose false positives (the literal substrings 'password=' and 'PASSWORD:' appearing inside text describing an unrelated .venv DLP-scanner false-positive issue, not real credentials) in build_history.json and a relay file, both covered by build-history immutability -- they are not to be edited to silence the scanner. For THIS push only: proceed with git push and gh pr merge; do not modify either flagged file. Record in your SESSION_CLOSE that these two findings were present, pre-existing, and explicitly accepted by this RELAY_DECISION, exactly as CI/PR #124 already established as precedent -- do not describe this movement's own privacy gate result as a clean PASS. This is a one-time exception for this specific push; it does not authorize ignoring any NEW finding this movement's own changes would introduce (none exist here per your own scan_repository() check).
